newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks feel more pressure, prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks feel more pressure, prices fall.

text.p: Estonian stocks felt further downward pressure on Tuesday, with some dealers seeing the market as expensive after a bull run in January.
They said the market may continue to suffer losses.
"Most dealers seem to accept the idea stocks are too pricey and are cautious about taking positions," said one trader.
The Tallinn stock exchange index fell 1.91 percent to close at 186.43 on official list turnover of 37.1 million kroons.
Tallinna Pank again had the highest trade on 10.4 million kroons of shares and it closed at 64.00, 1.75 kroons lower.
The bank has been suffering after a newspaper reported it was making big losses on a loan to a ferry company.
"The pressure on Tallinna Pank has eased, but the edge that it had as a lower price stock is now lost as other stocks have moved down as well," said another trader.
Equally active was Hansapank with trade of 10.1 million kroons to fall 3.15 kroons to 176.25 kroons.

Other stocks also closed down with Savings Bank 1.30 kroons lower at 87.70 on trade of 5.5 million kroons. Forekspank ended at 148.05 kroons after dipping 1.70 kroons with a turnover of 3.3 million kroons of shares.
On the over-the-counter market, trade was slow with only 7.6 million kroons changing hands.
Rakvere meat plant dominated the market with 5.6 million kroons of trade to finish the day lower 0.70 kroons lower at 14.20 kroons.
